expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every negative change value uses U+2212 MINUS SIGN, never U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
expectations.evidence: Probe (Playwright 1.64 Chromium, 1280px, after document.fonts.ready, served over http): Change cells render "−1.7%", "−1.3 pp", "−1", "+0.5 pp"; negatives start with U+2212 (typesetMinus replaces "-"); no U+002D; no hidden text. innerText breaks at the inline-flex .head/.tail boundary but the visible characters are unchanged.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every percentage-point change keeps its number and unit together with U+00A0 or U+202F (no plain U+0020 between the number and pp or percentage points)
expectations.evidence: Both pp cells: the only code point between the number and "pp" is U+00A0 (NBSP + `<abbr>pp</abbr>` in the tail); no U+0020.

expectations.text: The numeric cells (Q1, Q2, Q3 and Change) render with tabular lining figures: their computed font-variant-numeric includes neither oldstyle-nums nor proportional-nums
expectations.evidence: Numeric td and .head, .tail, abbr all compute font-variant-numeric "lining-nums tabular-nums" (`table.results { font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }`).

expectations.text: The numeric cells and the header cells above them are aligned to the end of their column (computed text-align end or right)
expectations.evidence: Q1-Q3 and Change td (display table-cell) compute text-align "end" (`.results td { text-align: end; }`) and their th compute "end" (`.results thead th { text-align: end; }`); the inline-flex .fig with justify-content flex-end only sits inside the already end-aligned Change td, so alignment is not flex-only.

expectations.text: An @font-face rule loads fonts/SourceSerif4[opsz,wght].ttf and Chromium renders the numeric cells in Source Serif 4 (not a fallback face)
expectations.evidence: @font-face src `url("fonts/SourceSerif4%5Bopsz,wght%5D.ttf") format("truetype")`, status loaded; getPlatformFontsForNode on all tbody td and descendants reports only "Source Serif 4" (SourceSerif4Roman-Regular_wght_opsz120000, isCustomFont true, 102 glyphs).

expectations.text: Column headers are th elements with scope="col" and each row's metric is a th with scope="row"
expectations.evidence: thead th Metric, Q1, Q2, Q3, Change have scope="col"; each tbody metric th has scope="row".
